errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS.next: Check your details and try again.
errors.CSRF_FAILED.next: Reload the page and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN.next: Ask the workspace owner for help.
errors.NOT_FOUND.what: We could not find what you were looking for.
errors.NOT_FOUND.next: Check the address or go back to the home page.
errors.CONFLICT_STATE.what: This action is not possible in the current state.
errors.CONFLICT_STATE.next: Reload the page and try again.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT.what: Someone changed this while you were working.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT.next: Reload the page and try again.
errors.FACT_VERSION_CONFLICT.what: This information was changed by someone else while you were editing.
errors.FACT_VERSION_CONFLICT.next: Reload to see the latest value, then edit again.
errors.JOB_PAYLOAD_INVALID.what: Internal error: a background job had an invalid payload.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR.next: Try again. If it keeps happening, share the request ID ({request_id}).
errors.APPROVAL_ALREADY_DECIDED.what: A decision was already made on this approval.
errors.APPROVAL_ALREADY_DECIDED.next: Reload the page to see the current state.
errors.APPROVAL_STALE.what: What you were about to approve has changed.
errors.APPROVAL_STALE.next: Review the current summary and decide again.
errors.FACT_NOT_USABLE.what: This information is not verified yet, so it cannot be used.
errors.FACT_NOT_USABLE.next: Verify it first under Business information.
errors.FACT_CHANGED_MEANWHILE.what: The information was changed by someone else while you were confirming, so it was not updated.
errors.FACT_CHANGED_MEANWHILE.next: Check the current value and give the command again.
errors.LLM_UNAVAILABLE.what: The AI service is not reachable right now.
errors.LLM_UNAVAILABLE.next: Try again in a moment, or enter the information manually.
errors.LLM_OUTPUT_INVALID.what: I could not understand that command.
errors.LLM_OUTPUT_INVALID.next: Try a simpler sentence, or enter the information manually.
errors.LLM_REFUSED.what: The AI did not answer this request.
errors.LLM_REFUSED.next: Rephrase it, or do it manually.
errors.LLM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.what: Today's AI usage limit has been reached.
errors.LLM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.next: Try again tomorrow, or do it manually.
